narration:
The same money, a different life.
For {identical_months} months you and the ghost were the same life, and in month {fork_month} you chose {real_choice} while the ghost took {ghost_choice}.
The money was furthest apart in month {widest_gap_month}, when the ghost had {widest_gap}.
The ghost's Freedom ended {freedom_gap}, and less of its pay was committed before each month began.
The ghost's Safety ended {safety_gap}, and it could last less long with no pay.
By month {end_month}, the ghost had {net_worth_gap}.
